value.rationale: The environmental rate fluctuations and slow-refresh localization crossovers are motivated by published one-particle statistical physics. Their effect on dependence between two separately resetting walkers is a different and natural unresolved observable. The exact finite-refresh pair correlation and its continuum of universal slow-refresh values, including log(2)/3 for exponential rate disorder, quantify a structural mechanism and reveal nontrivial dependence despite zero raw covariance and no synchronized resets. The variable near-zero density exponent has direct physical meaning and is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
